t: You're near the site of Thavie's Inn, a former Inn of Chancery associated with Lincoln's Inn. It stood in Holborn, close to what is now Thavies Inn Buildings, and it is one of the earliest Inns of Chancery on record, both in when it was founded and when it closed. Today a Lloyds Bank stands nearby, across Holborn Circus from Ely Place. The composer John Whitaker, who lived from 1776 to 1847, died here.
